question: Where was ‘Dev Deepawali Mahotsav’ celebrated in the presence of the PM Narendra Modi in November 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Varanasi**__.

__
 
• **Varanasi **was **‘Dev Deepawali Mahotsav’** celebrated in the presence of PM Narendra Modi in November 2020.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The Dev Deepavali ("**the Diwali of the Gods" or "Festival of Lights of the Gods**") is the festival of **Kartik Poornima** celebrated in Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, India.
 
• It falls on the **full moon of the Hindu month of Kartika (November - December)** and takes place **fifteen days **after Diwali.
 
• The steps of all the ghats on the riverfront of the **Ganges River**.
 
• The festival is also observed as **Tripura Purnima Snan**.
 
• The tradition of lighting the lamps on the Dev Deepawali festival day was first started at the Panchganga Ghat in 1985.
 
• During Dev Deepawali, **houses are decorated with oil lamps and coloured designs on their front doors**.
 
• **Firecrackers are burnt at night, processions of decorated deities** are taken out into the streets of Varanasi, and **oil lamps are set afloat **on the river.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• Varanasi is known as the 'Religious Capital of India'.
 
• **Kanpur** is known as the **'Manchester of North India'**.
 
• **Kanpur** is known as the **'Leather City of India'**.
 
• **Kanpur** is known as the **'Industrial and Economic Capital of Uttar Pradesh'**. 
 
• **Allahabad (Prayagraj)** is known as the **'City of Prime Ministers'**.**​**
 
• Mathura is one of the **seven sacred places of the Hindus **and the **birthplace of God Krishna**.
 
• Agra is the historical city of India famous as the **City of Taj Mahal**.
